title: CMS Transform Manifest Schema
description: Schema for transformation manifests that normalize OEM telemetry to CMS Signal Catalog format. All cms_field values MUST match json_field in the signal catalog DynamoDB table.

manifest_version.description: Version of the transform manifest schema

transform_type.description: Type of transformation. cloud_to_cloud for OEM API integrations.

source_name.description: Name of the data source (no OEM brand names in code — use generic identifiers)

source_format.description: Format of source data. JSON only for cloud-to-cloud.

connection.description: How data arrives from the OEM

type.description: rest_polling: poll their API in a loop. grpc_streaming: long-lived gRPC stream. websocket_inbound: accept inbound WebSocket connections.
oauth2 for most OEMs. api_key for simple integrations. mtls for inbound WebSocket.

credentials_secret_arn.description: ARN of Secrets Manager secret containing credentials

vehicle_id_extraction.description: How to extract the vehicle ID from the source payload

strategy.description: json_path: extract from nested path. direct: top-level field.

path.description: Dot-notation path to vehicle ID in source payload

timestamp_field.description: Field name in source payload containing the timestamp. Used as fallback when timestamp.modem_field is absent.

timestamp.description: v2.1.0: Dual-source timestamp declaration. When present, primary determines canonical event time. Falls back to top-level timestamp_field if modem_field is absent.

modem_field.description: JSONPath inside typed_data to the vehicle-side UTC timestamp (canonical event time)

ingestion_field.description: Top-level field name for OEM-server receipt time

primary.description: Which timestamp is authoritative for canonical event time

message_type_routing.description: v2.1.0: N-ary message routing rules. Replaces binary metric/event split. Missing → existing behavior preserved.

field.description: Field path whose value is matched against the pattern lists

telemetry_patterns.description: Substrings matched against the routing field value to classify as telemetry

event_patterns.description: Substrings matched against the routing field value to classify as events

discard_patterns.description: Substrings matched against the routing field value; matching messages are dropped. Missing → empty list (no discards).

event_mappings.description: v2.1.0: Per-event-type normalization rules. Missing → no event routing (v2.0.0 behavior preserved).

source_event_type_url.description: Fully-qualified @type URL from the source protobuf Any (e.g. type.googleapis.com/...)

cms_event_type.description: Canonical CMS event type emitted downstream

match.description:
Conditions that must all match for this mapping to apply. Supported predicates:
  - Any key except 'stringLabelEndsWith': equality match on the resolved dotted path in typedData.value (or root).
  - 'stringLabelEndsWith' (v2.2.0): typedData.value.stringLabel must end with the given string. Use for string_label TriggeredEvents (e.g. ':custom:vha-diagnostics-processed-event'). AND-semantics when combined with equality predicates.

stringLabelEndsWith.description: v2.2.0: Match when typedData.value.stringLabel ends with this suffix. For OEM1 custom events whose label includes a tenant UUID prefix (aui:event:<tenantId>:custom:<name>), suffix matching is the correct predicate shape.

extraction.description: JSONPath expressions for extracting event fields from the source payload

tag_aliases.description: Mapping from canonical tag names to OEM-specific tag key strings

default.description: Default passthrough mapping for severity strings

rules.description: Conditional overrides evaluated in order; first match wins

then.description: Output severity value when conditions match

uniqueness_key.description: Extracted field names that together form the deduplication key for this event type

signal_mappings.description: Array of signal transformation rules. cms_field values MUST match json_field in signal catalog.

cms_field.description: Target field name — MUST match json_field in signal catalog

source_path.description: Dot-notation path to value in source JSON payload

required.description: Whether this signal must be present in every message

default_value.description: Default value if source field is missing

unit_conversion.description: Named unit conversion. Use for standard conversions.

conversion.description: Custom conversion (use when named unit_conversion doesn't cover it)

value_map.description: Map source values to CMS values. Keys are source strings, values are CMS output.

required_fields.description: cms_field values that must be present in output

deferred_signals.description: v2.1.0: OEM signals with no current catalog match, explicitly tracked rather than silently dropped.

subscription_tier.description: v2.1.0: OEM subscription tier that determines which signals are available (e.g. Premium, Standard).
